protocol: real upstream Git histories; unmodified messages and diffs; labels selected before scores; no mocks or generated repositories
negative_selection: First ten manually reviewed documentation-only commits per project from the union of pinned windows, ordered by full SHA. Entire diff must contain prose/links only; source, build and generated behavioral changes are rejected. Unknown commits remain unlabeled.
population: Purposive small challenge set, not a representative estimate of all security fixes or production precision. Eligible means passes current disclosure/conventional-type filters; not equivalent to independently verified silent disclosure.
